title: Timber and Plaster Solid Wall, 2 m
description: Independent S03 modular village wall: 2 m repeat, 2.6 m height, 0.22 m plaster core and two-sided timber details. Matching X-end plaster profiles with 2 mm top-rail installation seam. Central stud has a deliberate 10 mm face offset from the lower rail; short junction shadows are geometric rebates. Cottage v2 supplies the appearance reference, not a directly interchangeable building system. Static visual module; no structural, collision or navigation claims.
